target.title: [codex] Support LM Studio vision classification
target.body:
## Summary

Adds an explicit OpenAI-compatible local vision classifier path for `photoscrawl classify`, so local model servers such as LM Studio can be used directly instead of requiring Ollama's `/api/generate` endpoint.

The existing Ollama path remains the default. The new path is selected with `--local-model-api openai` and accepts OpenAI-compatible base URLs such as `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1`.

## Verification

- `GOWORK=off go test ./internal/archive ./cmd/photoscrawl`
- `/Users/marianobelinky/Coding/openclaw/.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD --parallel-tests 'GOWORK=off go test ./internal/archive ./cmd/photoscrawl'`
- Local LM Studio smoke with `qwen3-vl-8b-instruct` loaded as `photoscrawl-qwen3-vl-8b`: `photoscrawl classify --local-model photoscrawl-qwen3-vl-8b --local-model-api openai --local-model-url http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 --limit 10 --json` wrote content observations with zero failures.
